'''April 2001 Paxtonia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Paxtonia Plaza, PA on 21 April 2001. [[Drew Scott]] won it. It is known from Drew Scott's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2124">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01d2124/ paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01d2124/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Paxtonia Plaza, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Drew Scott]]
